items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: If you notice, though, it's Cecil Taylor all alone.

ctx.x: People were preoccupied with what they were calling crossover, jazz rock and they weren't talking so much about avantgarde. But at those concerts, Cecil Taylor will still sell out and there they will be young college kids.
If you notice, though, it's Cecil Taylor all alone.
